title: Large-model-based smart agent for time series anomaly detection in power systems

claim.summary: SLEP combines temporal preprocessing, reflection-guided prompt improvement, and history/statistics/feature-enhanced power-series anomaly judgments around pretrained LLMs.

modules.name: Differencing and sliding-window preprocessing
modules.scope_reason: Differencing and windowing encode ordered numerical-series structure and can serve temporal tasks beyond anomaly detection.

modules.name: Stored self-reflections for iterative prompt improvement
modules.scope_reason: The stored answer/prompt critique and subsequent prompt revision do not require temporal or anomaly semantics.

modules.name: History-, statistics-, and feature-enhanced anomaly judgment
modules.scope_reason: The prompt specifies power-system anomaly judgment and a Normal/Abnormal output; enhancement policies supply evidence for that detection contract.
